requirements.description: Review the actual receiver's port/DC block, passive operation, RF ESD and coexistence/filter adaptation. Nominal 50 ohm does not establish host qualification or an antenna-specific tuning network.

Verify plastic mounting, 40 mm square installation provision, at least 10 mm separation from metal/main device ground, cable retention and supplied connector compatibility; preserve grounded host feed while clearing the external radiator.
Qualify complete host feed/launch/returns, selected stackup, support circuits, cable and installed antenna interface; quantify transmitter coupling and receiver rejection requirements.
Measure installed match, acquisition/tracking sensitivity and transmitter desensitization in actual enclosure and power/charging states.
